title: Investigating Gender Bias in Turkish Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Using Word Embeddings Association Test (WEAT) and Sentence Encoder Association Test (SEAT) to measure the cosine similarity between embeddings of male/female target concepts (such as given names and group terms) and attributes related to career/family, science/art, and double-bind stereotypes (competence and likability).
Applying WEAT and SEAT frameworks to compare the cosine similarity between word and sentence embeddings of Turkish versus Kurdish names and pleasant/unpleasant attributes.
